title: Arbitrary coproducts of quasi-coherent scheme modules
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $I$ be any set, and let $(\mathcal F_i)_{i\in I}$ be sheaves of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. If every $\mathcal F_i$ is quasi-coherent [pqf-def-coherent], their coproduct $\bigoplus_{i\in I}\mathcal F_i$ in the category of all sheaves of $\mathcal O_X$-modules is quasi-coherent. This includes an empty family.

source.place: Section 01LA (section-quasi-coherence), item (3); also the final sentence of Lemma 08DT in perfect.tex.

proof.text: This is the already proved source-library theorem AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.isQuasicoherent_sigma, WeilConjectures/AlgebraicGeometry/Modules/QuasicoherentKernel.lean, lines 313-321. Its proof restricts to all affine opens via fromSpec; restriction preserves coproducts. Each restricted summand admits its affine tilde presentation, and Presentation.sigma gives a presentation of the restricted coproduct. Transport that presentation along PreservesCoproduct.iso. These affine opens cover X, so isQuasicoherent_of_iSup_opensRange_eq_top proves quasi-coherence. The theorem has no finiteness or nonemptiness assumption on I. As a finished source-library declaration this node is a tool and is not split further.
